senses.gloss: (b. h.), גָּמָה, גָּמַע to take a draught, quaff; to sip, suck up. Y. Maas. Sh. II, beg. 53ᵇ he melted fat וגְמָעוֹ and sipped it; Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵃ top וגְמָייוֹ.
units: Sabb. XIV, 4 (111ᵃ) לא יִגְמָא בהן וכ׳ Ar. (ed. יִגְמַע, or יגַמּ׳ Pi., v. infra) he must not quaff vinegar through his teeth.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:4">Y. Maasr. III, 50ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כמה … לִגְמוֹת בכוס</he> how large a portion of the cup one must quaff at a time. Y. Shebi. II, end, 34ᵇ; Y. Ned. VII, beg. 40ᵇ the leaves of the colocasia must not be used (in case of a vow of abstinence from vegetables, or in the Sabbath year) <he>לגמות וכ׳</he> to sip water out of them (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Colocasia); a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 111a:5">Sabb. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>מְגַמֵּעַ ופולט תנן</he> (Ms. M. <he>לא יִגְמַע ויפלוט</he>) the Mishnah means, he must not quaff and spit out; <cite ref="Beitzah 18b">Bets. 18ᵇ</cite>; Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ top <he>מְגַמֵּא</he>; a. fr.
